fullPassage: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield. For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that way. A dancer who feels that a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising. In general, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or act in ways that help us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage. We also tend to do fewer things (or stop doing things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid acting in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.

ch: 행동의 결과에 따른 인간의 적응적 행동 변화
효과적인 운동 방법을 찾기 위한 전략

questions.passage: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield. For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that way. A dancer who feels that a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising. In general, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or act in ways that help us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage. We also tend to do fewer things (or stop doing things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid acting in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문 요지: 인간은 이로운 결과를 가져오는 행동은 반복하고, 불리한 결과를 초래하는 행동은 줄인다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 타고난 능력: 원문에 타고난 능력 언급 없음
❌ ② 반복 훈련: 결과에 상관없는 반복은 본문과 반대
✅ ③ 이로운 결과→반복, 불리한→줄임: 글 전체 요지 ←정답
❌ ④ 목표 설정: 원문에 목표 설정 언급 없음
det.tip: benefit → 행동 반복 / problem → 행동 감소

ch: 인간의 행동은 타고난 능력에 의해 결정된다.
성공적인 학습을 위해서는 반복 훈련이 가장 중요하다.
인간은 이로운 결과를 주는 행동을 반복하고 불리한 행동은 줄이는 경향이 있다.
행동 변화를 위해서는 구체적인 목표 설정이 필수적이다.
